products.description: Jennifer Lopez's One Eau De Parfum captivates with an elegant blend of floral and fruity notes, accentuated by warm undertones. Delicate jasmine and lily-of-the-valley provide a soft, sophisticated allure, harmonized with the fresh zest of bergamot and grapefruit.As the fragrance unfolds, hints of black currant and pink pepper add depth, while a rich foundation of vanilla and sandalwood offers comforting warmth. Sensual musk ensures a lasting impression, making this scent perfect for any occasion.
